subject.title: Feature Request: Add channel creation to message tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose Slack and Discord workspace/server channel creation through the message tool and CLI, and what default-off gates, scopes, and requester authorization should that surface require?
rationale: The feature would let agents mutate provider-side workspace/server structure, and current code has no accepted Slack channel-admin gate or cross-provider authorization boundary for this capability.

options.title: Approve default-off provider gates
options.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

options.title: Narrow to Discord CLI first
options.body: Treat the open Discord CLI PR as the only near-term work and leave Slack channel creation for a later security/product decision.

options.title: Decline native channel creation
options.body: Keep workspace and server provisioning in provider-native admin tools or external scripts unless stronger product need appears.

recommendation.title: Approve default-off provider gates
recommendation.body: Define explicit provider-owned channel admin gates and scopes, implement Slack channel creation behind them, and land or replace the Discord CLI subset after security acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history and prior review context across the affected CLI, Slack, and Discord action surfaces.
